notes.title: GAME RELEASE!
notes.content:
Hello, bread warriors!

Today is an important day for us because we’ve just released our first full game on Steam. And the best part? You can play it absolutely for free!

[u][b]Yes, you heard that right. The full version of Breadborn is available for free to everyone! :)[/b][/u]

So go check out the new trailer and download the game. Get ready for a thrilling gameplay experience, where you control Kolobok and his army of crumbly minions. Devour them for extra protection, send the little ones to attack enemies. But be careful — the local beasts love snacking on tiny pieces of bread.

[previewyoutube=8cKvgiFj42k;full]https://youtu.be/8cKvgiFj42k[/previewyoutube]

Arm yourself with a variety of weapons and fight your way through! All to lift the curses of Baba Yaga. And don’t worry about dying — each attempt grants you experience and a burning desire for revenge.

_________________

We’re eagerly awaiting your feedback and hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: What is Breadborn?
notes.content:
Greetings, bread warriors!

Today we are going to introduce you Breadborn a little bit closer! From the very beginning we would like to tell you who this game is created for. For those who love fun, hurricane and crazy gameplay, where anything can happen at any second. We always wanted to make a game that would make you think ‘oh, what is this, let me try it’. 

That's why we chose this concept. The main character is a Kolobok or you can know him as The Gingerbread Man. Depending on your desire he can become anything you want, we have prepared a full-fledged editor for this purpose. Colour, shape, emotions.. not as powerful as inZOI, of course, but you will definitely be able to mould your favourite crumb. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039710/efe30dfc0840ebd393b8a9f1e30fba6d97c8c822.jpg[/img]

What else.. weapons! There will be a lot of weapons. Close combat, ranged, medium combat, lethal and not so lethal. Want to fight back with a branch? Easy. A magic grabbing hand? Easy. Take a burst-firing Uzi? No problem at all. You can arm not only the main character, but also your army of minions. 

Remember how pleasant it was to watch minions following you everywhere in Overlord. How they destroy everything around at your command, pounce on your opponents. We tried to recreate exactly those feelings of an all-destroying crowd of small, a bit brainless, but dangerous allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039710/d290969d4761b61f69560aeae615204a0961c4b7.jpg[/img]

And what about the references? We absolutely adore them! So much so that we even put one of them in the title itself. Breadborn is not a dark game at all. Yes, it is difficult in some places, but in general there is not much in common between Breadborn and ‘you_know_what_game’. Although this very title perfectly characterises the main character. Coming out of the furnace, he was not by his own will born, not by his own will he is forced to fight. And by whose will? You will find out very soon ;)

We are just preparing a trial version so that you can personally evaluate the gameplay. Be sure to add the game to your wishlist so that you don't miss the moment when it will be released. Otherwise how we will contact you!?
